_metadata.description: Equipment care profiles, dispatch/return QC checks, storage rules, hard HOLD triggers, and 3-level diagnostic trees per category.

dispatch_checks: Visual sensor inspection (no dust, spots, OLPF scratches)
Lens mount inspection (zero mechanical play, contact pins clean)
Record test to approved media at maximum bitrate (4K 120p or RAW)
Media slot test (smooth card insertion, dual slot lock verification)
HDMI / SDI output feed verification on reference monitor
Audio XLR / 3.5mm input and headphone jack monitoring test
LCD touch screen, EVF, and physical dial/button response
Internal fan operation and zero thermal warning alerts
Firmware version verified against approved studio standard
Battery bay contacts clean and tension springs intact
return_checks: Chassis impact, dent, or exterior casing damage inspection
Mount tightness and screw retention check
Port inspection (HDMI port loose/cracked pins, SDI BNC wiggle)
Moisture or rain ingress detection on seams and ports
Media card removed and returned to client / formatted
Dead pixel / sensor spot test at f/16 against clean white field
Button and dial mechanical tactility test
Controlled 5-minute recording stress test
storage_rules: Store in electronic dry cabinet at 40-45% relative humidity
Body cap permanently installed whenever lens is detached
Battery removed for storage exceeding 48 hours
hard_hold_triggers: Sensor glass / OLPF scratch or persistent contamination
Lens mount play or visible deformation
Intermittent HDMI / SDI video signal drop
Overheating or recurring thermal shutdown error
Physical liquid ingress or internal corrosion

dispatch_checks: Front and rear glass inspection under high-intensity inspection light
Focus ring rotation (smooth torque across entire throw, zero gritty spots)
Aperture / iris ring rotation and clickless de-clicked movement
Zoom ring travel (consistent resistance, zero focal creep)
Lens mount flange inspection (zero burrs, tight lock on body)
Front filter thread roundness and thread condition
0.8M cine gear teeth inspection for wear or damage
Internal element inspection for fungus, haze, or oil on blades
Verify 15mm rod support requirement for heavy cine zooms
return_checks: Front glass scratch or coating abrasion check
Rear glass impact or mount wear check
Gear ring tooth damage or slipping under follow-focus pressure
Filter thread impact or cross-thread dents
Post-shoot humidity and fungus inspection
storage_rules: Store vertically in dry cabinet with front and rear caps sealed
Aperture ring set wide open to prevent spring tension fatigue
Silica gel desiccants maintained in hard cases
hard_hold_triggers: Element scratch in optical path, coating peel, or chipped glass
Internal haze, fogging, or fungal spores
Mount looseness or flange focal distance misalignment
Mechanical binding or frozen focus/zoom ring
Drop impact causing optical decentering

dispatch_checks: Three-axis automated motor unlock and smooth manual free movement
Motor strength and zero-vibration test under target camera load
Quick release baseplate, riser, and camera screws counted
Focus motor, rod mount, and control cables verified
Gimbal battery grip charge level (>= 90%) and latch lock check
Automated balance test and motor stiffness auto-tune
Joystick, touchscreen, and follow-mode profiles tested
return_checks: Gimbal arm inspection for drop scars or bent aluminum arms
Motor resistance or gritty feel when unpowered
Baseplate and locking lever wear check
Cable connector pins and port inspection
storage_rules: Stored in dedicated foam hard case with all 3 axis locks engaged
Battery grip detached if stored longer than 7 days
hard_hold_triggers: Persistent motor overload, jitter, or high-frequency oscillation
Bent or cracked carbon/aluminum arm assembly
Axis lock slipping or broken latching mechanism
Impact or water damage to main controller board

dispatch_checks: COB LED emitter surface visual inspection (zero cracks or burns)
Cooling fan boot test and acoustic noise check
Full dimming range check (0.1% to 100% flicker-free test)
Bowens / reflector mount latching and umbrella lock check
Mains power cord, ballast header cable, and plug integrity check
Yoke locking brake tension and 5/8" baby pin receiver check
Bluetooth Sidus Link / app connectivity check
return_checks: Ventilation intake and exhaust louvers checked for lint/dust
Ballast casing checked for heat discoloration or burnt smell
Power cable sheath checked for kinks, cuts, or exposed copper
Moisture inspection on fixture and control box
storage_rules: Protective COB cover must be clipped on before packing into case
Cables coiled in natural over-under loop without tight radius
hard_hold_triggers: Thermal shutdown trip or cooling fan failure
Damaged power cable or cracked ballast plug
Uneven LED phosphor discoloration or dead COB diodes
Any water immersion or burning odor

dispatch_checks: Visual casing inspection for physical impact, dents, or swelling
Terminal pins clean, uncorroded, and gold plating intact
OLED / LED fuel gauge test showing 100% full charge
D-Tap and USB-C PD port power output verified
V-mount / Gold mount wedge lock fit securely verified
return_checks: Swelling test: battery must sit completely flat on level surface
Post-use temperature check (abnormal heat dissipation)
Terminal damage or carbon arching marks
Voltage check with battery tester
storage_rules: Store at 40-50% nominal charge (approx 14.8V for V-mount) for idle periods
Keep away from metal surfaces and direct heat sources
hard_hold_triggers: ANY swelling, bulging, or case separation (Immediate destruction / retire)
Physical casing crack, puncture, or liquid exposure
Abnormal heat during charging or discharge
Unstable output voltage or terminal burn marks

dispatch_checks: TX and RX paired and transmitting clean video over HDMI and SDI
Serialized antennas counted and verified (correct band/polarity)
Channel selection switch and OLED frequency display verified
NP-F battery plate and DC barrel power input tested
1/4"-20 cold shoe mounting threads verified
return_checks: All antennas accounted for (zero missing antennas accepted)
Antenna connector threads checked for stripping or bending
HDMI / SDI port retention and video stability under vibration
storage_rules: Antennas unscrewed and stored in designated cutout slots
hard_hold_triggers: Antenna port RP-SMA connector snapped or stripped
Intermittent video frame drop on verified clean RF channel
Cracked OLED display or unresponsive channel pairing

dispatch_checks: C-stand and tripod leg locking collars tested under hand torque
Grip head T-handle and aluminum brake disc tension tested
Sandbag zipper, inner liner, and strap tested for zero leaks
Safety steel cables with locking carabiners counted with lights
Fluid head pan and tilt drag friction and counterbalance tested
return_checks: Bent aluminum riser tubes or tripod legs
Stripped locking knobs or cracked die-cast castings
Fluid head hydraulic fluid leaks or sticky pan travel
Sandbag weight and tear verification
storage_rules: Stands stored collapsed with locks loosened half a turn to prevent binding
Tripod heads locked in horizontal neutral position
hard_hold_triggers: Bent or buckled load-bearing tube
Cracked grip head casting or slipping locking brake
Leaking hydraulic fluid head
Frayed or damaged steel rigging safety cable

level_a_staff_safe.scope: Safe external checks performable by warehouse prep technicians
actions: Inspect and swap field cable with known-good studio reference cable
Swap camera battery / V-mount pack with fully charged known-good unit
Swap media card with certified known-good card and test recording
Perform camera / fixture reboot and factory profile reset
Inspect physical connector seating and cable strain relief
Check external antenna count, tightness, and orientation
Verify power socket voltage with multimeter before lighting burn test

level_b_technician_service.scope: Authorized internal technician evaluation with specialized tools
actions: Measure lens mount flange focal distance with collimator
Check connector pin retention force and ground continuity
Clean camera sensor OLPF with certified sensor swab and optical fluid
Replace worn quick-release plate levers or tripod rubber feet
Gimbal advanced IMU six-sided calibration and motor tuning
Clean internal fixture cooling fans with soft anti-static brush

level_c_stop_use_escalate.scope: Mandatory STOP USE, immediate quarantine, and factory service escalation
actions: Liquid intrusion, water immersion, or active condensation inside optics
Burnt electrical odor, smoke, or blown semiconductor component
Lithium-ion battery swelling, bulging, leaking, or shell puncture
Intermittent power short circuit or ground loop fault
Severe physical crack in structural cast alloy, carbon fiber, or lens mount
RED camera SDI driver IC failure
Cracked or scratched image sensor OLPF glass
